title: Was really hoping for better quality. A 3-star table.
text: Was really hoping for better quality. A 3-star table.. Didn't include instructions, but was pretty simple to figure out. The paint does chip easily during assembly even when you're being careful, so that was disappointing and it's a bit wobbly after assembly. There were only two anti-scratch pads included for the four legs, but the plastic feet included are good enough to protect the floor, so I used the two pads to even out the legs and stop thr wobbling. For thr price, I shouldn't have had to do that, but I like the look and color of the table that the pros even out the cons; hence the 3-star rating.
